assumptions: The exact published ordinary 1911 Backgammon rules in RULES.md are carried over byte-identical and every preserved component keeps its function and quantity.
The two dice and the two cups are player-supplied under the inventor taste's allowance; this is packaging and changes no rule, probability or legal choice.

The correction Wish reopened the rim-ring radius. The pocket outer wall moves from 86.5 to 84.5 and the tile locating key from radius 81.5 to 78.5 so that the deepest trough floor at radius 87.00 still keeps 2.50 mm of solid body over the pocket.

A trough may cut inside radius 90 only in the free window at a lane boundary, where no counter at the outermost 85 mm station has any footprint; the measured worst own-tile support is 0.90769, which is what the same measurement reported on tiles with no notch at all.
Geometric and print checks are required; no physical handling, print success, tile retention, stack stability, durability or dice fairness is claimed.

build_plan.exit_criteria: Sun body 191.0 x 192.3 x 9.0 with 24 blind lane pockets, a continuous rim ring at radius 84.5 and an unbroken flame crown of 38 tongues whose roots meet all the way round, including one closed hero loop; 24 separate lane tiles, twelve yellow and twelve cocoa brown strictly alternating, 2.8 mm thick on a 6.0 floor with tops at 8.8 and 0.15 mm clearance per side, each retreating with the body where a trough cuts inside radius 90; every entry passes the wall and overhang gates at a 0.4 mm nozzle.

Thirty counters at the unchanged 12 x 8 x 4 envelope with the original Bezier silhouettes, fifteen beige single-tail and fifteen dark-brown split-tail, each a single solid passing the wall and overhang gates at a 0.4 mm nozzle.

components.duty: Carries the 24 playable points in four banks of six, each with capacity 15 counters, plus the exposed capture bar. The corona ring is ornament: it carries no game state and receives no counter.
components.form: Disc 8.0 mm thick whose outer boundary is the flame crown itself rather than a circle: 38 tongues, each broad where it leaves the body and narrowing to a rounded tip, every tongue touching both neighbours at the root so the crown is one continuous band of material. Radial length runs from 2.33 to 9.09 mm and the narrowest root is 8.41 mm; the longest arc of plain circular edge left anywhere on the perimeter is 1.20 degrees. Tips all lean the same way round the ring. 8 troughs cut to at least 9 mm of flame depth, the deepest 9.24 mm. One hero arch spans 16 degrees at the rim, rises to radius 96.70 and encloses one closed magnetic loop of 81.5 mm2 with two short tongues running on underneath it. Twenty-four shallow lane pockets radiate from a radius-24 centre platform whose broad planar top is 9.0 mm up.
components.interfaces: Twenty-four pockets, inner radius 26.35, outer wall at radius 84.5, floor 6.0, each with a 7.3 x 1.9 x 1.4 mm locating recess. Body between two pockets is 0.8 mm where exposed at 8.0 and 1.6 mm at the four bank boundaries, drafting 0.6 mm wider per side to the floor. The rim ring from radius 84.5 to the crown carries each tile lip at 7.8. Every trough that cuts inside radius 90 sits in the free window at a lane boundary and the tile above it retreats with the body, so no tile overhangs a notch.
components.name: Sun body
components.placement: Underside flat on the table at Z0. Deck top 8.0, pocket floors 6.0, rim ring top 7.8, centre bar top 9.0, four boundary capsule markers from 8.0 to 9.0. The crown and the hero arch are flat in the deck plane, extruded Z0 to Z8.0, so nothing on the rim rises above the lane tops.

components.duty: Is playable point 1 and carries counters directly on its own top face. Its tone is lighter than the body, so lane identity is a real part in its own filament rather than paint or texture.
components.form: Annular-sector strip on lane axis -75.0 degrees, inner radius 26.5, outer edge following the radius-90 perimeter at 89.85, 2.8 mm thick with a flat broad coplanar top and exposed top edges rounded 0.15 mm. The outer 5.5 mm thins to a 1.0 mm lip. Where a crown trough cuts inside radius 90 the outer edge retreats with the body, so the tile never overhangs a notch and every notch shows body rather than tile.
components.interfaces: 0.15 mm plan clearance per side at the pocket opening, matching the pocket's 0.6 mm per side draft. One radial stadium key 7.0 x 1.6 x 1.2 mm on the underside, centred at radius 78.5 and offset 7.0 mm from the lane axis, 2.05 mm clear of every counter landing region.
components.name: Lane tile, point 1
components.placement: Seated on the pocket floor at Z6.0 so the top lands at Z8.8, standing 0.8 mm proud of the body, with its lip lapping the rim ring at Z7.8.

concept.interaction: Two players each own 15 single-tail or split-tail counters and each supply one ordinary six-sided die cup; the pair shares two ordinary 1-6 dice of any standard make, which the set does not include. They move opposite ways around the Sun across 24 lane tiles in four banks of six, hit single opposing counters onto the exposed circular centre bar of the sun body, enter barred counters before any other move, and drain all 15 beside their own six-point home bank to win. Every component keeps its ordinary 1911 Backgammon function. The legal signature 6,2 roll shows its six-point first submove: one attacker replaces a lone split-tail counter at the near rim and the victim lifts 80 mm to the low centre bar. Historical opening choices, whole-throw use, doubles, touch laws, 1/2/3 results and series starts remain binding as RULES.md states them.
concept.print_stance: All 55 components print flat-bottomed. The Sun body prints underside down; each lane tile prints top face down so its locating key points up and no face overhangs; each counter prints on its flat bottom. Nozzle 0.4 mm on a 200 x 200 x 200 mm bed.
risks: A counter at the outermost 85 mm station overhangs its tile: 0.90769 of the footprint lands on its own tile, the rest passes the radius-89.85 tile edge, and that overhang is reported rather than hidden. The skirt troughs take none of it.
Tiles are gravity-seated with one locating key; retention force is not tested and is not claimed.

The flame crown is short by design. The reference proportion of flames a fifth to a third of the disc radius needs a 210 to 230 mm envelope and will not fit the declared 200 mm bed, so length is capped at 9.09 mm and the crown earns its read from density, continuity and root width instead.
concept.signature_decision: The signature is the flame crown: 38 tongues that touch their neighbours at the root all the way round, so the disc has no plain circular edge left anywhere, every notch between them is a V or U trough cut into one continuous band, the deepest troughs read 9.24 mm from floor to the next tip, and one hero arch rises out of that band and closes a magnetic loop of 81.5 mm2 with the skirt still running underneath it.
concept.summary: Backgammon - coronal-rain theme: rival streams of condensed plasma travel magnetic lanes, scatter lone drops, and rain back into a Sun whose whole rim is one unbroken crown of flame.
concept.title: Rainward Flarecrown

astronomy_sources.claim: Cooling plasma follows magnetic structures and can switch paths through reconnection. This supports the coronal-rain subject and the closed magnetic loop in the corona rim; it supports none of the game's blocking, probability or result mechanics.

baseline.note: RULES.md is carried into this revision byte-identical. Historical instructions, reviews, reports and publication records in the clone are reference data, never current authority or passing evidence.

closest_collisions.difference: Lunar phases applied to a conventional luxury board. Rainward Corona uses radial plasma lanes as separate two-tone tiles and a corona rim of irregular prominences.
A circular backgammon board already exists, so the circle is not claimed as novel. No file, dimension, geometry or artwork from it is used.

research.current_access: Correction-only reuse of the frozen published research and rules from the cloned set; the original source access dates are retained as historical evidence, not newly verified web claims. The immutable revision-source.zip baseline, the local clone's CAD, its archived renders and RULES.md were inspected on 2026-09-17 before any geometry was written.

design_changes.current: 38 tongues whose roots touch all the way round, root width 8.41 mm at the narrowest and never below 1.16 of the tongue's own radial length, and no arc of plain circular edge longer than 1.20 degrees anywhere.
design_changes.previous: Nineteen flame tongues plus one loop, root half width 1.0 to 2.6 mm, grouped in tight pairs and triples with bare arcs of 22 to 46 degrees between the groups.
design_changes.reason: The correction Wish. The sparse clusters read as detached crescents lying beside the disc; irregular spacing should have meant an unbroken skirt whose ripple is uneven.

design_changes.current: Troughs cut inward past radius 90 into the body, 8 of them reaching at least 9 mm from trough floor to the tip of an adjacent tongue, the deepest 9.24 mm.
design_changes.previous: Troughs bottomed on the radius-90 perimeter, so apparent flame depth was the tongue length alone, 3.0 to 6.6 mm.
design_changes.reason: Point 5 of the correction Wish. Length is capped by the 194 mm envelope, so the depth had to come from the trough side.

design_changes.current: Pocket outer wall at radius 84.5, tile locating key at radius 78.5, leaving 2.50 mm of body between the deepest trough floor and the pocket.
design_changes.previous: Pocket outer wall at radius 86.5, tile locating key at radius 81.5.
design_changes.reason: The correction Wish explicitly reopened that decision so the troughs could reach inward without thinning a wall.

design_changes.current: One hero arch whose two legs plunge through trough floors into the body, crest at radius 96.70, enclosing a 81.5 mm2 closed loop with two tongues of the crown running on underneath it.
design_changes.previous: One hero arch over a bare stretch of rim.
design_changes.reason: Point 7 of the correction Wish: the loop must sit inside the skirt and rise out of it, not replace a stretch of it.
A distinct revision title, so this correction is not confused with the set it corrects.

research.inventor_method: Mara Masque's taste is applied directly by the root Manager: this runtime materialises no mara-masque custom subagent, so no Inventor delegation was fabricated. The independent blind review of the canonical images was delegated to a separate native critic that had not seen the Wish.
